description: Mentioned. He had his cloak round Sam.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Asked where he stands, and asked for no more Latin.
name: George Bryan

description: Set Tom's entrance and released you ten minutes early.
name: John Heminges

description: Mentioned. He was behind the tire-house door, out of the wind.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Named the crush in the arras if Pompey does not clear.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Placed George, asked that Sam be kept out of the wind, and left at 10:50.
name: William Shakespeare
